meta.provenance_note: SYNTHETIC forecast data generated from the versioned exit-gate scenario; not measured data, not a market price, and never presented as either.

seed.stream_rule: one splitmix64 draw per interval per power series, intervals in order

method.pv_shape: clear-sky cosine bell at the interval start instant, per the scenario pv_clear_sky profile: value = rated_power_mw * peak_factor * 0.5 * (1 - cos(2*pi*x)), x = (sod - sunrise) / (sunset - sunrise) on [0, 1), capped at rated_power_mw; 0 outside [sunrise, sunset); sunrise 05:30 UTC, sunset 21:00 UTC
method.load_shape: scenario load_baseline_reducible baseline at the interval start instant: night 0.25 * rated_peak_mw + morning 0.45 * rated_peak_mw * cosine_bump(sod, 07:30 UTC, half-width 2.5 h) + evening 0.50 * rated_peak_mw * cosine_bump(sod, 19:00 UTC, half-width 3.0 h), cosine_bump = 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * delta / half_width)) for delta < half_width else 0, capped at rated_peak_mw; emitted in the canonical net sign (consumption negative, P > 0 export)
method.availability: constant 1.000 per interval (fraction in [0, 1]); the scenario declares availability constant true; no noise
method.forecast_noise: value_raw = shape * (1 + u) with u drawn once per interval per power series from the stream keyed <asset_key>/forecast/<forecast_version>; u = low + unit * (high - low), unit = (draw >> 11) / 2^53
method.quantization: every value is quantized to whole milli units (round half away from zero) and rendered with exactly three decimals, so the artefact is byte-reproducible without float formatting
method.shape_note: ASSUMPTION: these are the scenario synthetic profiles evaluated on the P3.03 grid semantics, not a weather model, not measured data, and not a validated physical model; the central forecast is not a market price and carries no price data
